entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. This is ridiculous. I want to return a helmet I bought. Right now.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

I don't have time for twenty questions! It's the wrong color! The website made it look completely different. I hate it, and I want my money back. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched the thing!
I understand your frustration with the color not meeting your expectations. Let me just pull up your order information and our policy to see how I can best assist you.
There's nothing to 'assist' with. You're going to give me a refund, or I'm getting your manager on the line and plastering a one-star review on every website I can find. It's that simple.

That won't be necessary. I've just reviewed your order, and I see you received the item 18 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Oh. Well... good. That's what I expected.

Of course. We want to make sure you're completely satisfied with the gear you trust for your safety. Getting the right helmet, and the right color, is important. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email on file now. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Okay. A pre-paid label? So I just print it and stick it on the box?

That's correct. Just attach the label to the shipping box and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
